title: The cumulant distance: what is proved
claim: D0: delta is invariant under renaming and switching values; on complement-closed bases kappa_xy = C; |kappa| can exceed 1 (clamp); one knot is distance one under parity, NAE and betweenness. D1: on every parity base delta = least circuit through the pair - 2 = bond distance - 1. D2: on parity knot trees delta = steps apart. D3: on mixed chains kappa({ends} + parity pendants) = (-1/3)^a, so delta <= steps apart. D4: on NAE trees separated four-sets have kappa_4 = -2(-1/3)^(d(x,y)+d(u,v)) and never shortcut. D5: up to switching values a split line of m points is a ring of m (switching-invariant readings fold its L1).
standard_statement: Joint cumulants (Ursell functions) of +-1 variables; matroid circuits and connectivity; tree metrics from correlations; Seidel switching.
